title: Demand per copy
statementMd:
For the 5 books with the highest loans-per-copy ratio show title, copies, loans and the ratio rounded to 2 decimals. Break ties by title.

Expected columns: `title`, `copies`, `loans`, `per_copy`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
hints: Join aggregated loans to books and divide.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT b.title, b.copies, x.loans, ROUND(1.0 * x.loans / b.copies, 2) AS per_copy FROM books b JOIN (SELECT book_id, COUNT(*) AS loans FROM loans GROUP BY book_id) x ON x.book_id = b.id ORDER BY per_copy DESC, b.title LIMIT 5;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
